♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 E SE E FIHLILE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions e nang le **Your script** le **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, le **Flex Studio (Beta)** e jarollang pele ebe e o botsa pele e kengwa.

*(E kenye hodima phetolelo ya hao ya hajwale, ebe o qala After Effects bocha hang.)*

♦️ **E ncha: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Sebopeho sa **Map desk**, ho batla dibaka ntle le inthanete, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route le tse ding), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, mekgwa ya dimmapa ya mahala le **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Disebediswa tsa yona tse eketsehileng (ho hokahanya ka nako eo, mekgwa, mabitso, 3D, Finalize) jwale di bulehela ka nnete ka hare ho After Effects.

♦️ **Tse ncha ho AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (lerung, e sebedisa dikhredite tsa Flex AI) ke enjene e kgothaletswang, mme e kgethilwe hang bakeng sa bohle. Kgetha Whisper hape ho etsa dikhepshene mahala khomphutheng ya hao (Translate To e hloka Whisper). Ha seva e phathahane, e o bontsha sebaka sa hao moleng.
* **Your script**: dikhepshene di nka mopeleto le mantswe a script ya hao hohle moo o buileng mantswe ao.
* Sephetho sa **Editable template**: dikhepshene e le dilayara tsa template tseo o ka fetolang sebopeho sa tsona ho Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Ha ho letho le kgethilweng mme Source media e se na letho? E o fa **composition yohle**. Modumo o tshwanang o sebedisa transcript ya wona hape.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e jarolla pele, ebe e botsa **Install / Not now**.
* App (2.0.0-beta.2): dibaka tsa mosebetsi tsa **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, dikonopo tsa disebediswa jwalo ka ho After Effects, diklip di buleha hanghang, mme OPEN e sebetsa ho di-precomp le di-adjustment layer.

♦️ **Tse lokisitsweng**
* Diphello tsa theme tse neng di le siyo ho di-PC tse ngata tsa Windows di kgutlile (di le bobebe ha diphello tsa animation tsa Windows di timilwe).

♦️ **Sebaka sa boikgethelo bakeng sa ho sireletsa laesense**
* E botswa hang feela, mme ke ka boikgethelo: le ha o kgetha **No thanks** tsohle di ntse di sebetsa. O ka e fetola ho **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E bolokwa dikgwedi tse 12, ha e rekiswe le ka mohla, ebile ha e arolelwe le ka mohla ntle le moo molao o e hlokang.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 E SE E FIHLILE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack e fallela ho AutoCaptions** e na le mekgwa ya lentswe ka leng, dibopeho, motsamao le medumo. **UN-NEST** le di-blend mode di sebetsa ho Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ke ho tobetsa hang feela, mme **Flex Studio (Beta)** e bula klip ya hao ho tswa phaneleng.

*(E kenye hodima phetolelo ya hao ya hajwale, ebe o qala Premiere Pro bocha hang.)*

♦️ **E ncha: Dikhepshene tse tsamayang ho AutoCaptions**
* **Mokgwa wa lentswe**: fa lentswe lefe kapa lefe mebala ya lona, fonte le qetello ya Flat, Shine kapa Glow.
* **Dibopeho tsa mela**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside le Line.
* **Motsamao wa lentswe ka leng** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake le tse ding) le ponelopele, hammoho le medumo ya **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Mekgwa ya mantswe le motsamao di hloka sephetho sa **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (lerung, e sebedisa dikhredite tsa Flex AI) jwale ke enjene e kgothaletswang, mme e kgethilwe hang bakeng sa bohle; kgetha enjene ya Whisper ho etsa dikhepshene mahala ntle le inthanete.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): dikhepshene di nka mantswe a script ya hao moo o buileng mantswe ao.
* Ha ho letho le kgethilweng (karete ya Source e se na letho) e o fa **timeline yohle**; dikhepshene di bolokwa pela projeke ya hao.

♦️ **E ncha: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** e latela klip ka hare ho app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** e kgutlisa track. Ha e so kengwe? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e a e jarolla, ebe e botsa **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Tse fetohileng**
* **AUTO CUT** e hlahloba klip e kgethilweng mme e e seha ka ho tobetsa hang. **Retakes** e tshwara dipolelo tse qadilweng bocha.
* **Audio Studio** jwale e na le di-sub-tab tse tsheletseng. **Library** jwale e ho Nest Saver.

♦️ **Tse lokisitsweng**
* **UN-NEST** ho Premiere 26.5 (e ne e hana nest e nngwe le e nngwe), le di-blend mode tse kang Screen tse neng di kgutlela ho Normal (Premiere ka Senyesemane).
* Chip e kgubedu ya **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, ponelopele e ntsho ya Caption Stack, le diphello tsa theme tse neng di le siyo ho di-PC tse ngata tsa Windows.

♦️ **Sebaka sa boikgethelo bakeng sa ho sireletsa laesense**
* E botswa hang feela, mme ke ka boikgethelo: le ha o kgetha **No thanks** tsohle di ntse di sebetsa. O ka e fetola ho **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E bolokwa dikgwedi tse 12, ha e rekiswe le ka mohla, ebile ha e arolelwe le ka mohla ntle le moo molao o e hlokang.
